选择指数、训练/测试长度和策略参数。信号在收盘后形成，下一交易日开盘执行；自动选: Choose a stock universe, training and test windows, and strategy settings. Signals are formed after the close and executed at the next session’s open. Automatic selection uses training data only.

所有均线、历史波动率及流动性窗口都使用滞后数据；信号最早在下一交易日开盘执行。: Moving averages, volatility and liquidity measures use lagged observations. Signals cannot be executed before the next session’s open.
“训练集自动选参”仅在固定候选网格中按训练期超额 Sharpe 减换手惩罚排名，: Automatic selection ranks a fixed parameter grid by training-period excess Sharpe, less a turnover penalty. Test-period results do not enter this ranking.
手动反复查看测试结果属于多重检验，页面会标记为探索性，不应宣称为严格样本外证据。: Changing settings after inspecting test results introduces multiple-testing bias. Manual mode is exploratory, not independent out-of-sample evidence.
沪深300、中证500、中证800和中证1000使用 Qlib 逐时点历史成分；: CSI 300, 500, 800 and 1000 use Qlib’s historical index membership. The CSI 2000 and microcap universes are proxies based on lagged liquidity, not official index constituents.
结果为研究记录，不构成收益承诺或投资建议。: These results are research records, not investment advice or a promise of future returns.
A股市场情绪观察：六维情绪、近半年市场走势与最新QRS指数择时状态: A-share sentiment research: six daily signals, six months of market context and the latest QRS index overlay.
期权、融资、波动率、市场宽度、期现基差与股债成交统一为 −1 至 +1 的每日情: Six measures—options activity, margin financing, volatility, market breadth, futures basis and equity–bond turnover—form a daily score between −1 and +1. The separate QRS overlay studies index support and resistance. Where a release is delayed, the latest valid prior observation is used and its actual date remains visible.
最近一周，六项指标如何变化: Six signals over the past five sessions
数值下方标注方向信号；带“回退”者使用该日之前最近发布的真实数据。: Each value is followed by its directional signal. A carried observation comes from the most recent valid release available on that date.

三条曲线使用同一交易日横轴。情绪分使用左轴（−1 至 +1）；上证指数和沪深30: All series share the same trading-date axis. Sentiment uses the left scale (−1 to +1). Both indices use the right scale, rebased to 100 at their first valid observation. Grey sentiment points include at least one carried-forward input.
QRS 不是成分股选股模型，也不直接创造指数增强 Alpha；它是一层指数仓位覆: QRS is an index exposure overlay, not a stock-selection model or a source of index-enhancement alpha. It can adjust the risk budget of an existing portfolio. A reading above +0.15 switches to long exposure; below −0.15 switches to cash. Between the thresholds, the previous state is retained.
信号按当日收盘数据生成，策略回测从下一交易日执行。该表是独立择时观察，不参与上方: Signals use the closing data for the stated date; backtest execution begins no earlier than the next session. QRS is reported separately and is not included in the six-factor sentiment score.
六个维度各自产生 −1、0 或 +1 信号，再按既定权重加总。只有真实抓取数据进: Each component contributes −1, 0 or +1, combined using fixed weights. Calculations use retrieved market observations; missing data is never replaced with simulated values.
仅供量化研究，不构成投资建议: For quantitative research only. Not investment advice.

融合境内外预期博弈、南向资金、分析师网络与经典七因子，并以严格的可得时间控制每一: The framework brings together onshore and offshore expectations, southbound holdings, analyst networks and established equity factors. Every historical signal is constrained by when its inputs first became available.
所有信号都回答同一个问题：: Every signal starts with one question:
在这个交易日，当时真正知道什么？: What information was actually available on that trading day?

方法定义独立于当日是否有数据；只有完整通过来源与时间校验的 QMT 快照才会进入: Factor definitions remain available even when data is missing. Results appear only after the QMT snapshot passes source and timestamp validation.

时间边界，先于因子公式: Information timing comes before factor design
PIT 不是一次: Point-in-time handling is more than a
，而是贯穿事件生效、依赖传播与日频映射的知识时间体系。: . It tracks when events take effect, when every dependency is known, and how those observations map to trading dates.
信息从发生到可交易的时间路径: From a reported event to an eligible trading signal
每只股票、每个报告期只保留首次真实可得版本，后续修订不回写历史。: For each stock and reporting period, retain the first available release. Later revisions must not overwrite the historical record.
同比、差分和趋势先在报告期事件序列完成，再映射到日频。: Calculate year-on-year changes, differences and trends on the reporting-period sequence before mapping them to daily observations.
信号日只读取生效时间不晚于当日的数据，禁止未来回填。: A signal may use only observations effective on or before its date. Future releases cannot be backfilled.
收盘后披露的信息从下一交易日生效，不进入当日收盘信号。: Information released after the close becomes eligible on the next trading day, not in the same day’s closing signal.
复合指标以所有必要组成数据中最晚的可得时间为准。: A composite measure becomes available only when its last required input is known.
境内外预期差与三个月修订只比较同一财政预测期和统一口径。: Expectation gaps and three-month revisions compare the same fiscal forecast period using consistent definitions.
页面只从服务器读取最近一次经认证的 QMT 快照。没有完整数据时不绘图、不排名、: This page reads the most recent authenticated QMT snapshot. Without complete data, it shows no charts, rankings or simulated stock records.
没有数据，也不能降低验证标准: Missing data does not lower the validation standard
新增未来信息不得改写历史结果；来源不完整、时间不合法或标记为合成的数据会在 AP: Newly released information must not alter past results. The API rejects records with incomplete provenance, invalid timestamps or synthetic-data flags.
QMT 能提供的行情、成交额、持仓或已下载财务字段可进入实时链路。: Available QMT market prices, turnover, holdings and downloaded financial fields may enter the data pipeline.
境内外分析师一致预期、研报标题、评级上调和共同分析师网络必须有独立 PIT 数据: Onshore and offshore consensus forecasts, report titles, rating upgrades and shared-analyst links require separate point-in-time datasets. They remain unavailable when QMT does not supply them.
网站不会用固定五股样本、随机种子或公网数据填补缺口。: The site does not fill these gaps with a fixed sample, random values or substitute public-market data.
网页只读，不读取交易账户，不触发真实委托。: The site is read-only. It neither reads a trading account nor submits orders.
本页面展示因子方法与经验证的实盘快照状态，不构成投资建议或收益承诺。: This page documents factor methods and validated data availability. It is not investment advice or a promise of returns.
